methods.events: Boundary contact when frozen level lies within candle low/high, without tolerance; same-bar event order UNKNOWN. Strict high/low excursion followed by close inside on same bar; intrabar path UNKNOWN. Close outside starts contiguous episode; first subsequent inside close ends RETURN; opposite outside without inside close explicitly separate. Exact equality inside. No tolerance or acceptance threshold.
methods.causality: bounds available before probe; pivots not required to call range; late returns never modify earlier events. Episode terminal known only at its ending/as-of.
methods.economics: No PnL/win-rate grouping, filter or trades; no proof of sweep, rejection or accepted breakout.
